malformed id is 404, as on the other /agents/{id} routes.

get.description:
The whole result set (#84 (a)): no limit or cursor. The body is built
in full inside one read-only snapshot before the response starts, so an
over-cap or failing export never sends a CSV byte.

post.description:
Start a rebuild of both policy folders (TS §4.2); poll `GET /tasks/{id}`.
Before the catalog start-up ends, 503 with Retry-After (#102 (d)).

delete.description:
Soft-delete a policy (TS §4.3 L550, REQ-167) through the catalog
service, under the catalog lock; 204. #98 (e): unknown 404, already
deleted 409 `conflict`, server folder 409 `policy_managed_on_server`.
Before the catalog start-up ends, 503 with Retry-After (#102 (d)).

patch.description:
Sets the status with an override, or clears the override. Audited;
a re-enable alerts (#101). 409 for a deleted policy (#98 (c)).

post.description: Create a scan schedule; `next_run_at` is its next fire after now.

delete.description: Delete a scan schedule; the scans it started keep their rows.

patch.description: Change any non-empty subset of name, target, cron, timezone, enabled.

get.description:
Newest first; `created_after` inclusive, `created_before` exclusive;
`agent_id` matches the scan's resolved target (REQ-264).

post.description:
Queue one scan of a policy for a target (TS §6.4). With an
`Idempotency-Key`, a repeat with the same body returns the first 202.

get.description: Scan state and per-host summary, in one read-only snapshot (REQ-265).

post.description:
Cancel the scan's queued, dispatched and running jobs, manager-side
only (TS §4.4 L581); a repeat answers `cancelled_jobs: 0`.

Re-evaluate the scan's results against its policy's current version,
in the request (#147 (a)); adds rows only (TS §4.5 L603).

get.description:
One item per planned plugin of each host, by agent_id then payload
position (REQ-267); output only for operator and admin (REQ-268).
